title: FRM: Felix Runtime Module — papers and results
description:
Papers and results for FRM, the Felix Runtime Module, a bounded self-improving program-repair system tested in eleven preregistered studies against a published Level-4 definition of recursive self-improvement. The repository holds the synthesis of the first nine (Reach, Not Judgement), the Stage 3 (FELIX-C3) Level-4 test, the FELIX-C7 real-bug transfer study, the FELIX-C9 study of structural self-modification, and the FRM-11/12 paper on two later tests of a self-editing campaign layer: a replicated causal gain, an evidence-driven choice, and a failed sustained-progress criterion. It also holds per-seed result tables with a script that recomputes the reported statistics, the preregistrations and freeze records of the follow-up tests (T1, FRM-11, FRM-12), and an earlier preprint on the FELIX v4 self-evolving organism.

Each release of this record archives the GitHub repository euroized/FRM. To cite a paper, use that paper's own DOI, listed in the repository README.
